d: We are a group of luxury travel and mobility companies: Drive Luxury (chauffeur and ground transportation in more than 100 countries), Nextcorp (concierge and travel agency), Next Arrivals (airport VIP services) and Nextcars. We are building our own systems with AI at the core.

The Assistant Manager – IT Projects & Automation supports the IT Project Manager in planning, coordinating and delivering technology projects across all group companies, including Odoo, the in-house CRM, company websites, AI API integrations, business automations and AI tools. The role includes hands-on development and automation work.
Location: Manama office, on site, full time
Open to Bahraini nationals only. Fresh graduates are welcome.
q: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field
0–2 years of experience in IT projects, development or automation; internships and personal projects count
Hands-on coding in PHP (Laravel) and JavaScript / Node.js; Python, React or Vue.js, HTML/CSS and SQL (MySQL) are a plus
Understanding of APIs, webhooks and system integrations
Strong, hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) and AI APIs
Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; basic SQL is a plus
A plus: experience with CRM/ERP systems (Odoo preferred), automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n), RPA tools (Power Automate, UiPath or similar) and website platforms (WordPress, Wix)
Excellent English; Arabic is a plus
Proactive and quick to learn new tools
Clear communication with technical and non-technical teams
Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
Apply with your CV and a short note on one project or automation you built yourself.

d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
q: With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.
